arc.energy_shape_notes: Hold, fracture, collapse, rebuild louder. Near-silence intro (-49.1dB), entry -18.9dB, stable Eb-minor main body -14.2dB, fracture hole -22.0dB at 4:10, collapse valley -24.5dB at 5:05 (31s), then a 4+ minute rebuild climbing past the original level to the track maximum in the final 30s: RMS -8.7dB at 9:20, peak -1.4dB at 9:00. Crisis at 55% runtime; climax is the ending. Nominal dynamic range 40.4dB is set by the silent first window; working range excluding it is 15.8dB.

generator_hints.vocals: present and central; repetition ratio 0.887 (highest on the album so far); refrains: 'Never had a voice / Until the voltage entered', 'A lost thing can be found' x3, 'I didn't get the breaks' x6 inside the collapse valley; voice enters 7.6s

harmony.home_scale: Eb natural minor (Eb F Gb Ab Bb Cb Db), stable 1:00-4:30 at 0.75-0.82 confidence; whole-step collapse to C# natural minor (C# D# E F# G# A B) at ~5:00; back half oscillates C# minor / G# minor with C# major flashes (0.846 at 6:30, 0.722 at 8:00); ends on C# minor, a whole step below the opening key
progression_degrees: i-v oscillation in C# min with major flashes
signature_devices: Opening third-ambiguity on Eb: D# maj (0.73-0.74) flips to D# min (0.816) at 1:00.
Collapse as key change: whole-step drop Eb minor -> C# minor inside the quietest valley (-24.5dB at 5:05); modulation and dynamic floor coincide.

Back-half ambiguity unresolved by correlation data: C#/G# oscillation reads as either i-v motion with relative-major lifts or a third-toggle vamp on C# (C# min <-> C# maj). Both readings fit; do not force one.
Opening key never returns; track ends a whole step below where it started.
136.0 BPM verified by downbeat grid: 313 downbeats, mean interval 1.769s (135.6 BPM for 4-beat bars). Alternating 129.2 per-minute readings treated as estimator wobble.
First downbeat lands late at 11.19s, after a near-silent opening window - the grid is earned by withholding it.
Grid steady once established (intervals 1.67-1.90s); no half-time, no accelerando.
Drum pattern inside the bar (kick/snare/hats/swing) NOT established by feature data - see report Honest Limits; 'four' is a generative prescription, not a measured claim.

tempo.feel: 136 BPM, steady grid with a late first downbeat. The tempo does not move; the structure moves around it. The collapse and rebuild are dynamic and harmonic events, not rhythmic ones.

timbre.palette_notes: Brightest track so far: mean centroid 2433Hz (vs 1937Hz for track 01); main body 2400-3200Hz, rolloff up to 7234Hz, ZCR up to 0.1776. Fracture darkens first (centroid ~1400-1800Hz at 4:00-4:25) before the level collapses. Ending signature: spectrum collapses into the low end (centroid 618Hz, rolloff 1162Hz, ZCR 0.0115 at 9:15) WHILE level peaks (-8.7dB RMS) - loud and low at once, the track sinks instead of fading. MFCC2 shifts per section (60-90 bright body, 120+ fracture, 140-160 low ending) - real palette change at each turn.
